posts.author: TamakiSH
posts.body:
Hello! So I've been slowly understanding RMMZ, made some progress on my game flow and now I'd like to insight on menu building. I've looked through some posts and saw some plugins but I guess I want some insight from a more recent perspective.
Basically, I want to at least start with something basic that looks something like this. Doesn't have to 1 to 1 but I like the style of having busts, members side by side, etc. or something like Sacred Earth: Reverie.
I actually have all the assets ready I'm just having trouble finding the most straightforward way to approach building a menu. I'm currently using VisuStella plugins with MainMenuCore almost fitting my needs it's just I want to replace all the assets.
Whether it's a plugin or learning how to code it, I'll do it. This is sorta the same deal with the battle ui too but for now I wanna focus on the menu. Sorry for the blabbing just trying to get my point across the best way I can.
Thanks for reading and thanks in advance for any help!

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Well, it's a bit awkward that RPG Maker doesn't provide many settings to individualize ingame menues. That's one of the main reasons why many RPG Maker games "look the same".
That means, even something that looks basic (just as shown in your screenshot), is not simple to make in RPG Maker. Even programming something like "use portraits and make 4 individual windows instead of 1 big status window" is difficult to program due to how RPG Maker's code is written.
I would like to invite you to my plugin that I'm still developing just because I don't like how RPG Maker's limits force game devs to ask programmers just to implement menus. It's maybe not ready yet to output a menu as shown in the screenshot, but who knows, maybe it will be in a few months.
[MV & MZ] Custom Main Menu UI using WYSIWYG Editor
What is this Plugin?  This plugin comes packed with a UI tool that lets you customize your game's main menu!    Features  More than 6 premade layout configurations ...or arrange all windows as you wish Choose how your Actors should be rendered: Face, SV Battler, Map Sprite, custom Portrait...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Since you mentioned Sacred Earth: Reverie, doesn't that game use a lot of VS plugins since it's sponsored(?) by them or whatever. I assume it's quite heavily edited though.
For a menu like in Trails Sky Remake you posted, I think you can get close to that with VisuStella Main Menu Core and some code edits.
Select BG pic, select portrait mode, select commands on top, then in plugin settings change a couple of values so that the portraits can "overflow" from the itemRects. Then I guess you need to add yourself to get rid of the drawItemBackground in the main menu. Also remove the extra small windows and make the "main" window rect height a bit taller. And in plugin settings you can remove some of the info it draws and move around the rest. And change the data background size to fit only that area. Then I think it works if you just add your own line (blt) to draw that kind of border elements around the gauges etc. Though in the plugin code it draws a rectangle, if you want that kind of cut corner geometric shape I bet it can be done pretty easily, but don't know how myself.
